none: PAS CAM-276E31: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy radiate possibly of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate possibly of Claudius II. AD268-270, (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIA AVG]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left holding transverse sceptre and [ ]. Mint is possibly Milan. See Cunetio, p.139, c.f.2262-2264. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(?). Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.1g,…
